newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Camdessus confident on Thai handling of economy.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus confident on Thai handling of economy.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) chief Michel Camdessus said in Hong Kong on Friday he was confident about the way the Thai authorities were handling the country's financial sector problems.

"What they are doing is exactly what you must do to avoid the recurrence of a Mexico-like crisis," Camdessus told an IMF-Hong Kong Monetary Authority Conference on financial integration in Asia and the role of Hong Kong.
"The Thai authorities are taking gradual steps to address the kind of tensions which is only the other face of a very successful development policy," he said.

"I see them taking steps to address one of the vulnerabilities of the Thai economy... and after recently discussing with them I am confident that the measures and the programme for the future will have the potential to carry the economy back on track for sustainable growth," he said.
